title: Temporal paired sensing, consequential terrain errors and independent WildScenes inputs
dataset: TruckDrive seven clips; MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini ten recordings; GOOSE 31 selected frames; RADIATE tiny_foggy 17 eligible frames; WildScenes five selected frames
sensor_configuration: Existing paired TruckDrive/TruckScenes counts; RADIATE radar image contrast and LiDAR footprint counts; GOOSE VLS-128 XYZI with saved PTv3 predictions; WildScenes labelled XYZ
annotation_schema: Native object boxes and scene-qualified tracks; 64 GOOSE fine labels, eight challenge categories and separate provisional screening policy; native WildScenes labels and pinned author's 13-scored-class mapping
split: All shared earlier/follow-up TruckDrive keys, all corrected TruckScenes keys, original 24 plus seven GOOSE selections, all eligible fog frames, first chronological opt3d frame per five WildScenes recording groups (training examples)

environment.hardware: CPU analysis only; no new model inference or GPU runs

measurements.name: Forward TruckDrive vehicle tracks
measurements.scope: Aligned shared keys, exact boxes, abs azimuth <=15 degrees; sampled support, not recognised hazards

measurements.name: TruckScenes radar-only observations
measurements.scope: 25117 matched observations, per-point correction, exact boxes and one-return threshold; none persists for three sampled observations

measurements.name: Unique selected GOOSE frames
measurements.scope: Eight recording groups, 5378535 points; p64 baseline cohorts combined for directional diagnostics; p128 matched to seven only

measurements.name: Mixed half-metre columns with ground-truth firm majority
measurements.scope: 4232 observed columns containing firm terrain and rigid/person/vehicle hazard; provisional policy, XY columns may contain overhead geometry

measurements.name: Selected independent terrain points
measurements.scope: Five first chronological labelled WildScenes frames; not transfer inference or a representative benchmark

measurements.name: New raw sample bytes
measurements.scope: Ten WildScenes selected cloud/label files, all stored outside Git

notes: Successful execution of bounded descriptive studies. Modality fusion denotes analyses containing both modalities; no learned fusion score exists. Findings include seven candidate new decision messages and refinements of ten preserved messages. The twenty-distinct-message target, independent human clarity review and client acceptance remain outstanding. Physical passability, stopping, production latency and cross-dataset model transfer are unmeasured. Client reports and plans stay local.
